name: BottleValueSnapshot
description: A point-in-time valuation snapshot for a whiskey bottle. Used to track value history over time.

bottle_id.description: ID of the Bottle this snapshot belongs to

created_by.description: Email of the user who created this snapshot

retail_price.description: Known retail price at time of snapshot

aftermarket_price.description: Secondary / aftermarket price at time of snapshot

collector_value.description: Collector-community value estimate at time of snapshot

computed_current_value.description: Engine-computed canonical current value at time of snapshot

value_confidence.description: Confidence level of the computed value

source.description: What data source drove the primary value (e.g. Collector Value, Retail Price)

rarity_score.description: Engine-computed rarity score 0–100 at time of snapshot

replacement_difficulty.description: Estimated difficulty of replacing this bottle at time of snapshot

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about this valuation
